description: Asks whether a sort locale with contractions changes pattern cardinality, ranges and ordering: the same subjects (c, ch, cz, d, h, c-h, cha, ci, Ch, CH) in the General-sort main fixture (Pat group p09) and in the Spanish-sort fixture (Sp). Patterns c?, ?, ??, c*, [c-d], [c-d]*, ch, c[h]; comparisons S = 'ch', S < 'd', S > 'cz' and StrComp(S, 'd', 2); ORDER BY S. Both databases are open read-only on one engine and CollatingOrder is read for each.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
